description: Check whether a domain is set up to send and receive email. Returns its MX records and the mail provider they point at, its SPF record, its DMARC policy, a score out of 100 with a letter grade, the individual findings behind that score, and the next technical step. Reads public DNS only: no mail is sent, no mailbox is accessed, and no account or API key is required.

domain.description: Domain to check, e.g. example.com. A full URL or an email address is accepted and reduced to its hostname.

name: check_domain_setup
